title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3 privilege escalation was possible via Basic authentication with a restricted…
description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions prior to 2026.1.3. The issue arises when using Basic authentication with a restricted access token, potentially allowing an attacker with limited privileges to escalate their access. The vulnerability has a low severity rating and does not impact confidentiality or availability but may cause limited integrity issues.
